cz: 临时提升悟性，助修士参透玄奥之机
en: Temporarily improves insight and aids understanding.

cz: 临时降低速度，使其行动迟缓
附加火焰灼伤，持续掉血
附加剧毒，定时掉血且可叠加多层
en: Takes poison damage over time. Multiple layers can coexist.
Briefly staggered and unable to act.

cz: 临时封禁法术、技能与法器主动能力
en: Temporarily blocks spells and skills as well as active artifact abilities.

cz: 隐藏自身气息，使普通敌人无法锁定为攻击目标
en: Hides the actor from ordinary enemy targeting.

cz: 被法器镇住实体，暂时无法移动或行动
en: Held by an artifact and temporarily unable to move or act.

cz: 由重叠空间形成的临时防护屏障
en: A temporary barrier formed from overlapping space.

cz: 被终焉标记，生命垂危时更容易被斩杀
en: A mark that makes a critically wounded actor easier to execute.

cz: 持续受到诅咒伤害并被削弱攻防
en: Takes curse damage over time and loses attack and defense.

cz: 每秒恢复生命，较强的回春效果会覆盖较弱效果
en: Recovers health each second. A stronger effect replaces a weaker one.

cz: 暂时提高移动速度和攻击速度
en: Temporarily increases movement and attack speed.

cz: 肉身已毁，元婴必须在消散前找到合适宿主
en: The body is destroyed. The nascent soul must find a host before it fades.

cz: 神魂尚未适应新肉身，速度、伤害与神识降低，期间无法再次元婴出逃
en: The soul is adapting to a new body. Speed and damage are reduced along with spiritual sense. Another soul escape is blocked.

cz: 抵御夺舍留下的神魂损伤，暂时降低神魂与神识上限
en: Resisting possession temporarily reduces soul strength and spiritual sense capacity.

cz: 本相肉身刚刚重塑，速度、伤害与神魂承载暂时降低
en: A newly rebuilt body temporarily has reduced speed and damage as well as soul capacity.

cz: 接触扭劲损伤攻击能力，持续结束后恢复
en: Contact strain reduces attack power until the effect ends.

cz: 穿刺命中后降低实际护甲，持续结束后恢复
en: A piercing hit reduces actual armor until the effect ends.
